name: CK12 Designs
description: Nothing beats custom-crafted, in our opinion. Regardless of how you slice it, custom-made takes the cake. Our wood comes from native Oklahoma trees that have died naturally, been cut down by a homeowner, or been rescued from a warehouse demolition. Local Oklahomans are employed at CK12 Designs, which creates handcrafted custom furniture.
